run_gmock_class_tests: run the unittest test suite for gmock_class mock generation from C++ source
test_generate_mock_methods: test that virtual C++ methods are converted to MOCK_METHOD macros correctly
test_generate_mock_classes: test that C++ classes are converted to Mock* classes with mock methods
test_constructor_destructor_filtering: test that constructors and destructors are ignored when generating mock methods
test_template_class_mock_generation: test that templated C++ classes generate MOCK_METHOD_T macros with renamed template params
